messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — planning to ship release v2.4.2 (hotfix bundle) today. I want to run a sanity dry-run of the internal announcement + runbook pin at 14:30 PT before the actual blast at 15:00 PT. Can we validate rollback steps and the canary plan?

taylor: ack. I'll prepare the rollback snippet and put it in the runbook. Rollback targets: primary -> v2.4.1, emergency -> revert/2026-03-21. Adding commands now.

nina: RN draft ready. Key callouts: kernel fix for small-batch memory leak, quant tweak for 8-bit paths, and known embedding edge-case on long contexts. I added a "Known regressions" bullet.

kai: Oncall window OK for 14:15-16:00 PT. Canary policy: start with 5% traffic for 10min, then 25% for 15min. Abort if error rate >4% for 3m or 95th latency +30% vs baseline.

sam: perfect. taylor, paste the rollback command here (so comms can include it).

taylor: pasted in runbook and here: 

./infra/ctl rollback --to v2.4.1 --reason "canary-failure" --force

ops-bot: ops-bot: runbook updated: https://runbooks.internal/releases/v2.4.2 (pinned).

nina: comms draft subject line proposal: "Internal: v2.4.2 hotfix — 15:00 PT (canary)". Should we include the canary dashboard link?

sam: yes include dashboard. Use https://dash.internal/releases/1850009999-canary. Add a short "If you see issues" section: ping @kai and run rollback.

kai: noted. I'll be monitoring and will execute rollback if thresholds met. Also added a 1-liner for SRE runbook: verify KV hit-rate and model-serving memory.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled: 15:05 PT -> route 5% to v2.4.2, duration 10m. Will report status in-thread.

taylor: tiny RN edit: call out that embeddings may require reindex for the next batch job. Added to known issues.

nina: approved final RN. prepping the internal blast. Who's sending?

sam: I'll send the blast at 15:00 PT. Doing a 30min dry-run now at 14:30 PT: posting the draft to the channel for last-minute checks.

ops-bot: ops-bot: dry-run posted. Reminder: include rollback snippet and dashboard link in the blast.

sam: sending dry-run now.

(deploy-bot updates will follow in real time during the canary)

kai: all set here. If abort needed, I'll paste the rollback invocation and a short incident summary in this thread.

sam: thanks everyone. Dry-run looks good; final send at 15:00 PT unless anything urgent pops up. :rocket:
